findings.body: The test asserts the complete sequence of display names, but checks most bank IDs only for uniqueness. Changing an unasserted slug while keeping its display name would still pass, even though cards and brand shortcuts depend on those IDs. Assert the expected ID and name pair for every seeded bank.
findings.title: Not done: seeded bank IDs test

findings.body: The separator class recognizes only ASCII spaces, hyphens and slashes. A variant such as `1–2–3` or `1 2 3` passes despite containing three digits separated by dashes or spaces. Include common Unicode spaces and dashes in the guard.
findings.title: Reject card-like digits separated by typographic spaces or dashes

findings.body: The module currently registers only the bank controller. The add and edit API refusals, concurrency guarantees, and reminder and error placement on the web screens therefore remain for T1B, T1D, T4E and T4B, as assigned in the story plan.
findings.title: Later: T1B, T1D, T4E and T4B complete the refusals and reminders

findings.body: This branch supplies the contact address and tests a corrected name in GET /banks, but has no card-view endpoint or add screen. T1C owns the renamed name in both card views; T4E owns the visible mailto request button.
findings.title: Later: T1C and T4E complete the bank request and renamed-card views
